test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

You should tell these children to complete their projects himself.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****their projects himself****',** i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of the pronoun 'himself'.
 
• **Pronouns: **a word that can function by itself as a noun phrase and that refers either to the participants in the discourse or to someone or something mentioned elsewhere in the discourse.
 
• Here, in the given sentence, **'himself'** is used to replace the noun 'children' which is a plural noun, therefore, will require a plural pronoun.
 
• **Example:** 
 
 
• They were digging the ground **themselves**.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, **'themselves'** will be used in place of '**himself'.**

 

Correct sentence: __*You should tell these children to complete their projects **themselves.***
